words.enDefinition: Instructions for reaching a place on foot

examples.en: I opened the walking directions before leaving the student residence for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 出学生宿舍去看展之前，我打开了「步行指引」。

examples.en: The walking directions led past the garden and through a narrow passage.
examples.zh: 「步行指引」让我经过花园，再穿过一条窄通道。

words.enDefinition: A path planned for reaching somewhere on foot

examples.en: The walking route on the map started beside the university sports hall.
examples.zh: 地图上的「步行路线」从学校体育馆旁边出发。

examples.en: We chose a walking route through the park to see the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们选了一条穿过公园的「步行路线」去看新展览。

words.enDefinition: How long a walk is expected to take

examples.en: The app showed the estimated walking time from my flat to the museum.
examples.zh: 应用显示了从我住处到博物馆的「预计步行时长」。

examples.en: I checked the estimated walking time before agreeing to meet my classmate downtown.
examples.zh: 答应和同学在市中心见面之前，我看了「预计步行时长」。

collocations: an estimated walking time on the map

words.enDefinition: Access to a place for people on foot

examples.en: The garden map showed pedestrian access beside the main gate near our flat.
examples.zh: 花园地图标出了我住处附近大门旁的「行人通道」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was pedestrian access from the park into the courtyard.
examples.zh: 我问从公园到院子有没有「行人通道」。

words.enDefinition: A path intended for people walking

examples.en: The footpath behind the garden led to a quieter entrance to the park.
examples.zh: 花园后面的「步行小路」通向公园一个比较安静的入口。

examples.en: We met on the footpath beside the stream after finishing our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上午的讲座结束后，我们在溪边的「步行小路」碰面。

words.enDefinition: A path open to walkers and cyclists

examples.en: The map marked a shared-use path between the river and the sports grounds.
examples.zh: 地图在河流和运动场之间标出了一条「步行骑行共用道」。

examples.en: We picked a meeting point beside the shared-use path near the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们选了桥附近「步行骑行共用道」旁的一处地点碰面。

collocations: a sign for a shared-use path

words.enDefinition: A path set aside for cycling

examples.en: The cycle path through the park ended beside the public garden entrance.
examples.zh: 公园里的「自行车专用道」通到公共花园入口旁就结束了。

examples.en: The map showed a cycle path running behind the station toward the river.
examples.zh: 地图标出车站后面有条通向河边的「自行车专用道」。

collocations: a cycle path through the park

words.zhGloss: 有隔离设施的自行车道
words.enDefinition: A bike lane physically separated from motor traffic
acceptedZhAnswers: 有隔离设施的自行车道

examples.en: The protected bike lane was easy to spot beside the low concrete barrier.
examples.zh: 矮混凝土隔离栏旁的「有隔离设施的自行车道」很容易认出来。

examples.en: The map marked a protected bike lane along the road beside our campus.
examples.zh: 地图标出了我校旁边那条路上的「有隔离设施的自行车道」。

collocations: a protected bike lane along a road

words.enDefinition: A planned or marked route for cyclists

examples.en: The signs for the cycle route all had the same green bicycle symbol.
examples.zh: 「骑行路线」的指示牌上都有同样的绿色自行车标志。

examples.en: I checked whether the cycle route went near the hall where we were meeting.
examples.zh: 我查了「骑行路线」会不会经过我们要见面的大厅附近。

words.enDefinition: A system of connected routes for cyclists

examples.en: The brochure maps the cycle network around the university and the town centre.
examples.zh: 手册画出了学校和市中心周围的「骑行路线网」。

examples.en: The two riverside paths form part of the local cycle network shown here.
examples.zh: 这里标出的两条河边小路都属于本地的「骑行路线网」。

collocations: a map of the cycle network

words.enDefinition: A route separated from ordinary motor vehicle traffic

examples.en: The map showed a traffic-free route between the park and the university library.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了公园和学校图书馆之间的「无机动车路线」。

examples.en: We met where the traffic-free route leaves the riverside and enters the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在「无机动车路线」离开河边、进入花园的地方碰面。

collocations: a traffic-free route through the park

words.enDefinition: A street set aside for people walking

examples.en: The market stalls were set up along a pedestrian-only street behind the gallery.
examples.zh: 摊位摆在美术馆后面一条「仅供行人通行的街道」上。

examples.en: One side of the square opened onto a pedestrian-only street with several cafés.
examples.zh: 广场的一侧通向一条有几家咖啡馆的「行人专用街道」。

words.enDefinition: A bridge intended for people on foot

examples.en: We used the footbridge over the canal to reach our classmate's flat.
examples.zh: 我们从运河上的「人行桥」过去，到了同学住的公寓。

examples.en: The footbridge was easy to see from the path near the garden.
examples.zh: 从花园旁的小路很容易看到那座「人行桥」。

words.enDefinition: A walkway made of boards or decking

examples.en: I followed the boardwalk along the waterfront until I saw the museum entrance.
examples.zh: 我沿水边的「木板步道」走，直到看到博物馆入口。

examples.en: The boardwalk was wider near the platform where visitors stopped to take photos.
examples.zh: 访客停下来拍照的平台附近，「木板步道」更宽一些。

words.enDefinition: A waterside path once used for towing boats

examples.en: We followed the towpath along the canal until we reached the second bridge.
examples.zh: 我们沿着运河边的「旧纤道」走，直到第二座桥。

examples.en: The sign showed a connection from the towpath to the city garden.
examples.zh: 指示牌标出了从「运河边的旧纤道」通往城市花园的路线。

words.enDefinition: A wide public walkway often beside water

examples.en: We walked along the promenade before meeting our classmates at the exhibition.
examples.zh: 去展览上和同学碰面前，我们沿「滨水散步道」走了走。

examples.en: The café had a small door opening directly onto the promenade.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有扇小门，可以直接走上「滨水散步道」。

words.enDefinition: A point where two or more paths meet

examples.en: I saw the yellow route marker at the path junction beside the pond.
examples.zh: 我在池塘旁的「小路交汇处」看到了黄色路线标记。

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the path junction near the old stone wall.
examples.zh: 我们约在旧石墙旁的「小路交汇处」碰面。

words.enDefinition: A place where one path divides into two

examples.en: At the fork in the path, I checked which branch led toward the gallery.
examples.zh: 到了「小路的岔口」，我确认哪一支通往美术馆。

examples.en: We met at the fork in the path where both routes were marked.
examples.zh: 我们在两条路线都有标记的「小路岔口」碰了面。

collocations: reach a fork in the path
a marker at the fork in the path
stop at a fork in the path

words.enDefinition: A notice that there is no onward passage

examples.en: The map marked no through route beyond the courtyard during the exhibition.
examples.zh: 地图标明，展览期间院子后面的路「不可穿行」。

examples.en: I saw a “No through route” notice at the entrance to the narrow lane.
examples.zh: 我在窄巷入口看到了「前方不可穿行」的牌子。

collocations: a map showing no through route
a path marked no through route

words.enDefinition: A smaller street leading off a main street

examples.en: The community garden entrance was on a side street behind the library.
examples.zh: 社区花园的入口在图书馆后面的一条「从主路岔出的小街」上。

examples.en: I nearly missed the side street because the street name faced the other direction.
examples.zh: 我差点错过那条「岔出的小街」，因为路名牌朝着另一边。

collocations: a side street off the main road

words.enDefinition: A sign displaying the name of a street

examples.en: I looked up at the street name sign to check the address.
examples.zh: 我抬头看了「路名牌」，核对地址。

examples.en: The street name sign was mounted on the wall above the corner door.
examples.zh: 「路名牌」装在拐角那扇门上方的墙上。

collocations: a street name sign on the wall
look for the street name sign

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a building on a street

examples.en: The house number was partly covered by leaves when I reached the gate.
examples.zh: 我到门口时，「门牌号」有一部分被树叶挡住了。

examples.en: I checked the house number before sending my classmate a message to say I'd arrived.
examples.zh: 我确认了「门牌号」，再给同学发消息说到了。

words.enDefinition: A map setting for journeys on foot

examples.en: I switched to walking mode after getting off the bus near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近下公交后，我切换到了「步行模式」。

examples.en: The app showed a shorter path through the gardens in walking mode.
examples.zh: 应用在「步行模式」下标出了一条穿过花园的更短路线。

words.enDefinition: A navigation setting for bike trips

examples.en: I chose cycling mode to see which park entrance connected to the cycle path.
examples.zh: 我选了「骑行模式」，看看公园哪个入口连着自行车专用道。

examples.en: In cycling mode, the map showed routes on both sides of the river.
examples.zh: 在「骑行模式」下，地图显示了河流两岸的路线。

collocations: plan a route in cycling mode

words.enDefinition: A map available without an internet connection

examples.en: I saved an offline map before leaving the flat for our afternoon walk.
examples.zh: 下午出门散步前，我保存了一份「离线地图」。

examples.en: The offline map still showed the streets near my friend's new place.
examples.zh: 「离线地图」仍然显示了朋友新住处附近的街道。

words.enDefinition: A blue map marker showing the user's location

examples.en: The blue dot appeared beside the park entrance after the map finished loading.
examples.zh: 地图加载完后，代表当前位置的「蓝点」出现在公园入口旁。

examples.en: I zoomed in because the blue dot was close to two parallel streets.
examples.zh: 我放大了地图，因为代表当前位置的「蓝点」靠近两条平行街道。

collocations: the blue dot on the map
a blue dot showing your location

words.enDefinition: To mark a chosen place on a map

examples.en: Could you drop a pin where the riverside path meets the park entrance?
examples.zh: 你能「在地图上打个标记」，标出河边小路和公园入口相接的地方吗？

examples.en: I asked my roommate to drop a pin by the building's side door.
examples.zh: 我让室友「在地图上标一下」那栋楼的侧门。

collocations: drop a pin on the map
drop a pin at a meeting point
ask someone to drop a pin

words.enDefinition: To turn a map to face a different direction

examples.en: I had to rotate the map so the street in front of me matched it.
examples.zh: 我得「旋转地图」，让图上的方向和眼前街道一致。

examples.en: Can you rotate the map until the bridge appears at the top?
examples.zh: 你能「旋转地图」，把桥转到画面上方吗？

collocations: rotate the map on your screen

words.enDefinition: To enlarge the map to show more detail

examples.en: I had to zoom in on the map to see the smaller path.
examples.zh: 我得「放大地图」，才能看到那条较小的路。

examples.en: Could you zoom in on the map so we can read the street name?
examples.zh: 你能「放大地图」，让我们看清路名吗？

collocations: pinch to zoom in on the map
zoom in on the map for details
need to zoom in on the map

words.enDefinition: A sequence of directions for individual turns along a route

examples.en: The app offered turn-by-turn directions for the walk from campus to the market.
examples.zh: 应用为从学校走到市场的路程提供了「逐步导航指引」。

examples.en: I turned off the sound but kept the turn-by-turn directions on my screen.
examples.zh: 我关了声音，但屏幕上仍然保留了「逐步导航指引」。

words.enDefinition: A view of the planned route before starting

examples.en: The route preview showed a bridge halfway between the library and our destination.
examples.zh: 「路线预览」显示，图书馆和目的地之间的中途有一座桥。

examples.en: I opened the route preview to check which streets the app had chosen.
examples.zh: 我打开「路线预览」，确认应用选了哪几条街。

collocations: a route preview on the map

words.enDefinition: To refer to a recognizable place for orientation

examples.en: I decided to use a landmark rather than remember every street name on the route.
examples.zh: 我决定「用地标作参考」，省得记路线上的每个路名。

examples.en: Could you use a landmark to explain which park entrance you mean?
examples.zh: 你能「用地标作参考」，解释一下你指的是公园哪个入口吗？

collocations: use a landmark as a reference

words.enDefinition: A sign or symbol indicating a particular route

examples.en: A route marker beside the bench showed which path led around the pond.
examples.zh: 长椅旁的「路线标记」指明了哪条路绕着池塘走。

examples.en: The route marker at the next junction matched the one on our paper map.
examples.zh: 下一个交汇处的「路线标记」和纸质地图上的一样。

collocations: a route marker on a post

words.enDefinition: To continue in a direction slightly to the left

examples.en: The directions said to bear left where the path divided near the water.
examples.zh: 指引说，小路在水边分岔时要「略向左走」。

examples.en: I was told to bear left after the wooden sign by the park gate.
examples.zh: 有人告诉我，过了公园门边的木牌后要「略向左走」。

words.enDefinition: To continue in a direction slightly to the right

examples.en: The route note said to bear right just beyond the bench in the shade.
examples.zh: 路线说明说，过了树荫里的长椅就「略向右走」。

examples.en: I checked both paths when the voice on my phone said to bear right.
examples.zh: 手机语音提示「略向右走」时，我看了看两条路。

collocations: bear right onto the main path

words.enDefinition: To turn into the second road or path on the right

examples.en: The directions said to take the second right after passing the campus gate.
examples.zh: 指引说，过了校门后要「在第二个路口右转」。

examples.en: Should I take the second right before I reach the old stone bridge?
examples.zh: 在到旧石桥之前，我应该「在第二个路口右转」吗？

collocations: take the second right after the gate
need to take the second right
remember to take the second right

words.enDefinition: To change direction and enter a particular route

examples.en: I watched for the sign before deciding where to turn onto the riverside path.
examples.zh: 我先留意指示牌，再决定从哪里「转入河边小路」。

examples.en: The map showed where to turn onto the lane leading to the public garden.
examples.zh: 地图标明从哪里「转入通往公共花园的小巷」。

words.enDefinition: To pass somewhere without stopping while on foot

examples.en: We needed to walk past the old café before reaching the museum's side door.
examples.zh: 我们得「步行经过」那家老咖啡馆，才能到博物馆侧门。

examples.en: Does the route make us walk past the garden before turning left near the bridge?
examples.zh: 这条路线是要我们先「走过」花园，再在桥边左转吗？

collocations: walk past a row of shops

words.enDefinition: To move from one side to the other

examples.en: The park map showed where to cross over to the other side of the stream.
examples.zh: 公园地图标出了从哪里能「走到对岸」。

examples.en: I asked where we could cross over to the path on the other side.
examples.zh: 我问我们可以从哪里「走到对面」那条小路。

collocations: cross over to the other side

words.enDefinition: To continue along the route of a path

examples.en: I decided to follow the path until it reached the gate near the river.
examples.zh: 我决定「沿着小路走」，直到河边的门口。

examples.en: Can we follow the path behind the garden to get back to the library?
examples.zh: 我们可以「沿着花园后面的小路走」回图书馆吗？

collocations: follow the path along the river
follow the path to the gate

words.enDefinition: Very close to the near side of a junction

examples.en: The footpath entrance was just before the junction beside the public garden wall.
examples.zh: 「快到路口时」，在公共花园围墙旁就能看到那条步行小路的入口。

examples.en: I saw the street name sign just before the junction near campus.
examples.zh: 我「快到学校附近那个路口时」看到了路名牌。

collocations: a path just before the junction
a sign just before the junction

words.enDefinition: Following the edge of a developed area beside water

examples.en: The directions took us along the waterfront before turning inland toward the gallery.
examples.zh: 指引让我们先「沿着滨水地带」走，再往里拐去美术馆。

examples.en: We found a place to sit along the waterfront near the old warehouse.
examples.zh: 我们在旧仓库附近「沿水一带」找了个地方坐下。

words.enDefinition: Painted lines that identify a pedestrian crossing

examples.en: The crosswalk markings were much easier to see on this side of the square.
examples.zh: 广场这一侧的「人行横道标线」容易看清得多。

examples.en: My classmate pointed to the crosswalk markings while explaining where we should meet.
examples.zh: 同学在说明碰面地点时，指了指「人行横道标线」。

words.enDefinition: A pedestrian crossing marked with wide white stripes

examples.en: The zebra crossing outside the British museum looked newly painted that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，英国那家博物馆外的「斑马线」看起来刚刷过。

examples.en: I found the café my friend meant beside the zebra crossing near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的「斑马线」旁找到了朋友说的咖啡馆。

collocations: a zebra crossing outside a building

words.zhGloss: 有信号灯控制的过街点
words.enDefinition: A crossing where traffic lights regulate movement
acceptedZhAnswers: 有信号灯控制的过街点

examples.en: The map identified a signal-controlled crossing near the path beside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 地图标出了体育馆旁小路附近一处「有信号灯控制的过街点」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was a signal-controlled crossing between the two campus entrances.
examples.zh: 我问学校两个入口之间有没有「有信号灯控制的过街点」。

collocations: a signal-controlled crossing at a junction

words.zhGloss: 英式人行与骑行共用过街点
words.enDefinition: A British signal-controlled crossing for pedestrians and cyclists
acceptedZhAnswers: 英式人行与骑行共用过街点

examples.en: The tour guide in Bristol pointed out the toucan crossing near the harbour.
examples.zh: 布里斯托尔的导游指给我们看港口附近的「行人与骑行者共用过街处」。

examples.en: The label toucan crossing appeared where the cycle route met the main road.
examples.zh: 骑行路线和主路交汇的地方标着「行人与骑行者共用过街处」。

collocations: a toucan crossing on a cycle route
a sign for a toucan crossing

words.enDefinition: A crossing built higher than the surrounding road

examples.en: The raised crossing outside the hall was nearly level with the footpath.
examples.zh: 大厅外的「抬高式人行横道」和步行小路几乎一样高。

examples.en: I spotted the raised crossing shown on the map beside the garden entrance.
examples.zh: 我看到了地图上标注的「抬高式人行横道」，就在花园入口旁。

collocations: a raised crossing near a building

words.enDefinition: A traffic signal intended for people walking

examples.en: We waited beside the pedestrian signal while my classmate checked the meeting address.
examples.zh: 同学核对碰面地址时，我们在「行人过街信号灯」旁等。

examples.en: The diagram showed the pedestrian signal on the opposite side of the road.
examples.zh: 示意图标出了马路对面的「行人过街信号灯」。

collocations: a pedestrian signal at a crossing

words.enDefinition: A crossing signal displaying the walk phase

examples.en: The diagram showed a walking figure as an example of a walk signal.
examples.zh: 示意图用一个行走的小人作为「行人通行信号」的示例。

examples.en: I asked my classmate what the walk signal looked like at that crossing.
examples.zh: 我问同学，那个过街点的「行人通行信号」长什么样。

collocations: the walk signal at a crossing

words.enDefinition: A signal telling pedestrians not to start crossing

examples.en: The picture showed an orange hand used for the don't walk signal in that city.
examples.zh: 图片画了一只橙色的手，那座城市用它作为「行人禁止通行信号」。

examples.en: I compared the walk signal with the don't walk signal in the orientation booklet.
examples.zh: 我对照看了迎新手册里的行人通行信号和「行人禁止通行信号」。

collocations: a sign showing a don't walk signal

words.enDefinition: A button used to request a crossing signal

examples.en: The pedestrian crossing button was on a post beside the corner flowerbed.
examples.zh: 「行人过街按钮」在拐角花坛旁的一根柱子上。

examples.en: I asked what the light beside the pedestrian crossing button meant in that diagram.
examples.zh: 我问示意图中「行人过街按钮」旁边的灯表示什么。

collocations: a pedestrian crossing button on a post
the light beside the pedestrian crossing button

words.enDefinition: An audible cue associated with a pedestrian crossing

examples.en: I could hear the audible crossing signal from the corner near the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆附近的拐角能听见「有声过街信号」。

examples.en: The accessibility map identified an audible crossing signal beside the east park entrance.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出了公园东门旁边的「有声过街信号」。

collocations: a crossing with an audible crossing signal

words.enDefinition: A timer on a pedestrian signal showing time remaining

examples.en: The pedestrian countdown was displayed underneath the walking figure on the sign.
examples.zh: 「行人过街信号倒计时」显示在牌子的行走小人下方。

examples.en: The orientation leaflet showed a pedestrian countdown beside a diagram of the junction.
examples.zh: 迎新宣传页在路口示意图旁展示了「行人过街信号倒计时」。

collocations: a crossing with a pedestrian countdown

words.enDefinition: Someone assigned to assist people at a crossing

examples.en: A crossing guard was standing by the school gate beside our meeting point.
examples.zh: 一位「引导行人过街的人员」站在我们碰面地点旁边的校门口。

examples.en: I asked the crossing guard which of the nearby streets led to campus.
examples.zh: 我问那位「引导行人过街的人员」，附近哪条街通往学校。

collocations: a crossing guard near the gate

words.enDefinition: A raised space between lanes for people crossing

examples.en: The photograph showed a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the wide road.
examples.zh: 照片显示，宽阔的道路中间有一处「行人过街安全岛」。

examples.en: I saw the pedestrian refuge island marked on the accessibility map outside the hall.
examples.zh: 我在大厅外的无障碍地图上看到了「行人过街安全岛」的标记。

collocations: a pedestrian refuge island in the road

words.enDefinition: A lowered section of kerb beside a road

examples.en: The accessibility map marked a dropped kerb outside the entrance to the public garden.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出了公共花园入口外「降低的路缘石」。

examples.en: I asked whether the corner by the library had a dropped kerb.
examples.zh: 我问图书馆旁的拐角有没有「降低的路缘石」。

collocations: a dropped kerb at the crossing
a path with a dropped kerb

words.enDefinition: A route that does not involve steps

examples.en: I checked whether the step-free route to the museum went through the park.
examples.zh: 我查看了去博物馆的「无台阶路线」会不会穿过公园。

examples.en: The map showed a step-free route between the two sides of campus.
examples.zh: 地图标出了贯通校园两侧的一条「无台阶路线」。

words.enDefinition: A way to enter or reach somewhere using a ramp

examples.en: I asked whether there was ramp access from the riverside path into the garden.
examples.zh: 我问能不能从河边小路「经坡道通行」进入花园。

examples.en: The map showed ramp access at the entrance facing the university sports hall.
examples.zh: 地图显示，面向学校体育馆的那个入口「可经坡道通行」。

words.enDefinition: A path without a hard constructed surface

examples.en: The unpaved path was marked in a different colour on the garden map.
examples.zh: 花园地图用不同颜色标出了「未铺装小路」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unpaved path continued past the second bridge along the river.
examples.zh: 我问沿河的「未铺装小路」过了第二座桥还有没有。

collocations: an unpaved path through the garden

words.enDefinition: A footway surface with bumps or level changes

examples.en: The route notes mentioned uneven pavement between the main road and the garden entrance.
examples.zh: 路线说明提到，主路和花园入口之间有一段「不平整的人行道」。

examples.en: I saw a warning about uneven pavement beside the campus construction fence.
examples.zh: 我在学校施工围栏旁看到提示「人行道不平整」的警示牌。

words.enDefinition: A paving slab that shifts out of place

examples.en: I noticed a loose paving slab beside the sign at the park gate.
examples.zh: 我注意到公园门边的指示牌旁有一块「松动的铺路板」。

examples.en: A cone marked the loose paving slab near the corner of the campus walkway.
examples.zh: 学校步行道拐角附近摆了个路锥，标明那里有块「松动的铺路板」。

collocations: a loose paving slab near a gate

words.enDefinition: Small stones lying freely on a surface

examples.en: The route description mentioned loose gravel on the path beside the canal.
examples.zh: 路线说明提到，运河旁的小路上有「散落的碎石」。

examples.en: I could hear loose gravel under my shoes on the way to the garden.
examples.zh: 去花园的路上，我能听见鞋底踩在「散落的碎石」上的声音。

words.enDefinition: A narrow walking area alongside a road

examples.en: The map note described a narrow pavement on the bridge toward the gallery.
examples.zh: 地图说明写着，通往美术馆的桥上有一段「狭窄的人行道」。

examples.en: The narrow pavement widened again beside the gates of the community garden.
examples.zh: 「狭窄的人行道」到了社区花园大门旁又变宽了。

collocations: a narrow pavement beside a wall

words.enDefinition: A surface that rises or falls sharply

examples.en: The route description noted a steep slope near the public garden's back gate.
examples.zh: 路线说明写着，公共花园的后门附近有一段「陡坡」。

examples.en: I could see the steep slope from the bench where my classmate was waiting.
examples.zh: 我从同学等我的长椅那里能看到那段「陡坡」。

collocations: a steep slope on the route
a sign warning of a steep slope

words.enDefinition: A surface that rises or falls gradually

examples.en: The path behind the museum ran along a gentle slope toward the water.
examples.zh: 博物馆后面的小路沿「缓坡」通向水边。

examples.en: The accessibility map showed a gentle slope on the route past the library.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出经过图书馆的路线上有一段「缓坡」。

collocations: a path with a gentle slope
a gentle slope toward the river

words.enDefinition: A section of a route that goes uphill

examples.en: The route preview marked an uphill stretch just before the park entrance.
examples.zh: 路线预览标出了公园入口前「一段上坡路」。

examples.en: We stopped at a bench after the long uphill stretch near the hall.
examples.zh: 走完大厅旁那「一长段上坡路」后，我们在长椅旁停了下来。

collocations: the start of the uphill stretch

words.enDefinition: A notice that a route has only stairs

examples.en: I saw a “Stairs only” sign beside the path to the upper garden.
examples.zh: 通往上层花园的小路旁有块牌子，写着「只能走楼梯」。

examples.en: The map labelled the shortcut “Stairs only” near the smaller campus entrance.
examples.zh: 地图在学校较小的入口旁把那条近路标为「只能走楼梯」。

words.enDefinition: A walking path provided for a limited period

examples.en: The temporary walkway ran between two barriers beside the closed path near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近关闭的小路旁，两道隔栏之间有条「临时步行通道」。

examples.en: A volunteer showed us where the temporary walkway reached the park entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我们看「临时步行通道」在哪儿接上公园入口。

words.enDefinition: A crossing provided for a limited time

examples.en: The town map marked a temporary crossing near the entrance to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 镇上的地图标出展览入口附近有一个「临时过街点」。

examples.en: I asked where the temporary crossing was after seeing the work on the corner.
examples.zh: 看到拐角处在施工后，我问「临时过街点」在哪儿。

collocations: a sign for a temporary crossing
a temporary crossing near a junction

words.enDefinition: A notice that a walking path cannot be used

examples.en: The barrier had a “Footpath closed” notice just beyond the park entrance.
examples.zh: 刚过公园入口的隔栏上挂着「步行小路关闭」的告示。

examples.en: I saw “Footpath closed” on the map before leaving the university library.
examples.zh: 离开学校图书馆前，我在地图上看到「步行小路关闭」的提示。

words.enDefinition: A replacement route for people on foot

examples.en: The notice showed a pedestrian diversion around the construction site beside the park.
examples.zh: 告示在公园旁的施工区周围标出了一条「行人绕行路线」。

examples.en: I checked where the pedestrian diversion ended before leaving to meet my roommate.
examples.zh: 出发见室友前，我查了「行人绕行路线」在哪里结束。

words.enDefinition: A sign showing a way around a blockage

examples.en: The detour sign pointed toward the side street behind the closed footpath.
examples.zh: 「绕行指示牌」指向封闭步道后面的小街。

examples.en: I stopped beside the detour sign to read the small map on it.
examples.zh: 我在「绕行指示牌」旁停下，看它上面的小地图。

words.enDefinition: To go along an indicated alternative route

examples.en: The map said to follow the diversion around the garden to reach the library.
examples.zh: 地图说要「沿绕行路线走」，绕过花园去图书馆。

examples.en: We had to follow the diversion because the footbridge was closed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午人行天桥封闭，我们只能「沿绕行路线走」。

collocations: ask where to follow the diversion
follow the diversion around the site

words.enDefinition: To travel by a route avoiding part of the usual way

examples.en: We had to take a detour when the path through the square closed.
examples.zh: 穿过广场的路关闭后，我们得「绕路」。

examples.en: I asked whether we would need to take a detour on the walk back.
examples.zh: 我问走回去时需不需要「绕路」。

collocations: take a detour around the site

words.enDefinition: Work carried out to build or repair roads

examples.en: The signs for the roadworks were visible from the path outside the garden.
examples.zh: 从花园外的小路能看到「道路施工」的标牌。

examples.en: I checked the map while my classmate read the notice about the roadworks.
examples.zh: 同学读「道路施工」告示时，我查看了地图。

words.enDefinition: A temporary solid fence around construction work

examples.en: The notice was attached to the construction hoarding beside the diversion sign.
examples.zh: 告示贴在绕行指示牌旁的「施工围挡」上。

examples.en: I followed the path as it curved around the construction hoarding near campus.
examples.zh: 我沿小路走，绕过学校附近的「施工围挡」。

collocations: a notice on the construction hoarding

words.enDefinition: A temporary structure used to support workers or materials

examples.en: The route notice mentioned scaffolding beside the corner of the old gallery.
examples.zh: 路线告示提到，老美术馆拐角旁搭了「脚手架」。

examples.en: I could see scaffolding above the temporary walkway on that side of the street.
examples.zh: 我看到街道那一侧的临时步行通道上方有「脚手架」。

words.enDefinition: A notice that people cannot continue there on foot

examples.en: The sign said “No pedestrian access” where the path reached the construction gate.
examples.zh: 小路走到施工门口的地方立着牌子，写着「行人禁止通行」。

examples.en: I saw “No pedestrian access” on one side of the temporary fence.
examples.zh: 我在临时围栏的一侧看到了「行人禁止通行」的标示。

words.enDefinition: A sign telling cyclists to get off their bikes

examples.en: The “Cyclists dismount” sign was at the footbridge entrance near the market.
examples.zh: 市场附近的人行天桥入口处有块牌子，写着「骑行者请下车」。

examples.en: I asked what “Cyclists dismount” meant after seeing it on the park sign.
examples.zh: 在公园看到「骑行者请下车」的牌子后，我问这是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A notice that cycling is prohibited there

examples.en: The park map marked the area around the pond “No cycling” in red.
examples.zh: 公园地图用红色将池塘周围标为「禁止骑行」。

examples.en: I saw a “No cycling” sign near the narrowest part of the path.
examples.zh: 我在小路最窄的地方附近看到一块「禁止骑行」的牌子。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement that gives people on foot precedence

examples.en: The town map marked pedestrian priority in the square beside the public library.
examples.zh: 镇上的地图把公共图书馆旁的广场标为「行人优先」。

examples.en: A sign at the entrance explained the pedestrian priority area around the market.
examples.zh: 入口处的牌子说明了市场周围的「行人优先」区。

words.enDefinition: A cycling track serving both directions

examples.en: The map showed a two-way cycle track beside the road leading to campus.
examples.zh: 地图在通往学校的路旁标出了一条「双向自行车道」。

examples.en: I asked where the two-way cycle track ended near the riverside park.
examples.zh: 我问河边公园附近的「双向自行车道」在哪里结束。

collocations: a sign for a two-way cycle track

words.enDefinition: A traffic signal specifically for bicycle traffic

examples.en: The cycle signal had a bicycle symbol that stood out from the others.
examples.zh: 「自行车信号灯」有个自行车图案，从其他信号灯里很容易认出来。

examples.en: The junction diagram showed the cycle signal beside the one for pedestrians.
examples.zh: 路口示意图将「自行车信号灯」画在行人信号灯旁边。

collocations: a cycle signal at a junction
a cycle signal with a bicycle symbol

words.enDefinition: To walk while pushing the bicycle beside you

examples.en: The sign asked you to walk your bike along the narrow stretch beside the garden.
examples.zh: 牌子请大家经过花园旁狭窄的一段时「推着自行车走」。

examples.en: Do you need to walk your bike through the passage, according to that notice?
examples.zh: 按那张告示，过通道时需要「推着自行车走」吗？

collocations: ask you to walk your bike
walk your bike through the passage
walk your bike beside the gate

words.enDefinition: A service for short-term use of shared bicycles

examples.en: The city added bike share to the local transport map beside the cycle network.
examples.zh: 市里在本地交通地图上新增了「共享单车服务」标记，放在骑行路线网旁。

examples.en: I used bike share to meet my classmate near the riverside market.
examples.zh: 我用了「共享单车服务」，去河边市场附近和同学碰面。

words.enDefinition: An app for finding and renting shared bicycles

examples.en: I opened the bike-share app to see where the nearest bikes were.
examples.zh: 我打开「共享单车应用」，看看最近的车在哪儿。

examples.en: The bike-share app showed no open docks at the station nearest the gallery.
examples.zh: 「共享单车应用」显示，离美术馆最近的站点没有空车桩。

collocations: a map in the bike-share app

words.enDefinition: A bicycle available to use for a fee

examples.en: The rental bike had a basket large enough for my small backpack.
examples.zh: 这辆「租赁自行车」有个车篮，装得下我的小背包。

examples.en: I asked whether the rental bike was available for the afternoon ride.
examples.zh: 我问下午骑行能不能用这辆「租赁自行车」。

words.enDefinition: A bicycle whose motor assists when you pedal

examples.en: The app marked each pedal-assist bike with a different symbol on the map.
examples.zh: 应用用不同的符号在地图上标出每辆「脚踏助力自行车」。

examples.en: I asked which station had a pedal-assist bike available for our afternoon trip.
examples.zh: 我问哪个站有「脚踏助力自行车」可用，方便我们下午出门。

words.enDefinition: A shared bicycle that uses no fixed dock

examples.en: I checked whether the dockless bike could be returned near the public garden.
examples.zh: 我查了这辆「无桩共享单车」能不能还在公共花园附近。

examples.en: The app showed a dockless bike parked across the street from our classroom.
examples.zh: 应用显示，教室马路对面停着一辆「无桩共享单车」。

collocations: a dockless bike near the entrance

words.enDefinition: A site with docks for shared bicycles

examples.en: The docking station beside the river had room for several more bicycles.
examples.zh: 河边的「共享单车停靠点」还可以再停几辆自行车。

examples.en: We picked a meeting point near the docking station outside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 我们选了体育馆外「共享单车停靠点」附近的一处地点碰面。

collocations: return a bicycle to a docking station

words.enDefinition: An unused space for returning a shared bicycle

examples.en: The map showed one empty dock at the station beside the public garden.
examples.zh: 地图显示公共花园旁的站点有一个「空车桩」。

examples.en: I checked for an empty dock before choosing where to end the ride.
examples.zh: 决定在哪里结束骑行之前，我先找了找有没有「空车桩」。

collocations: a station with an empty dock

words.enDefinition: A docking station with no empty spaces

examples.en: The app marked a full docking station near campus when I looked for somewhere to return the bike.
examples.zh: 我找还车地点时，应用标出了学校附近一个「车桩已满的停靠点」。

examples.en: We met near a full docking station and looked for another one on the map.
examples.zh: 我们在一个「车桩已满的停靠点」附近碰面，然后在地图上另找了一个。

collocations: a warning about a full docking station
a full docking station on the app

words.enDefinition: A bicycle that can currently be rented

examples.en: The app showed one available bike outside the entrance to the riverside park.
examples.zh: 应用显示河边公园入口外有一辆「可租用的自行车」。

examples.en: I looked for an available bike before agreeing to meet my classmate at the market.
examples.zh: 答应在市场和同学见面之前，我先找了有没有「可租用的自行车」。

collocations: a station with an available bike

words.enDefinition: The identifier assigned to a particular rental bike

examples.en: I checked the bike number against the one displayed in the app.
examples.zh: 我核对了「单车编号」是否和应用里显示的那一个一致。

examples.en: The support form asked for the bike number printed below the seat.
examples.zh: 客服表单要求填写印在车座下方的「单车编号」。

collocations: a bike number on the frame

words.enDefinition: To arrange for a bike to be held for you

examples.en: Can I reserve a bike before heading to the docking station near my flat?
examples.zh: 我去住处附近的停靠点之前，可以先「预约一辆单车」吗？

examples.en: The app let me reserve a bike while I waited for my classmate.
examples.zh: 应用允许我在等同学时「预约一辆单车」。

collocations: use the app to reserve a bike

words.enDefinition: To release a bicycle so it can be used

examples.en: The app showed where to tap to unlock a bike at that station.
examples.zh: 应用显示，在那个站点要点击哪里才能「解锁一辆单车」。

examples.en: Could you unlock a bike from this station using the same app as mine?
examples.zh: 你能用和我一样的应用，从这个站点「解锁一辆单车」吗？

collocations: use the app to unlock a bike
be able to unlock a bike

words.enDefinition: To read a bicycle's code with a device

examples.en: The app asked me to scan the bike code when I picked a bicycle.
examples.zh: 我选好自行车时，应用让我「扫描单车码」。

examples.en: Where do I scan the bike code if this label is hard to read?
examples.zh: 如果这张标签看不清，我要在哪里「扫描单车码」？

collocations: prompt someone to scan the bike code
use the app to scan the bike code
try to scan the bike code

words.enDefinition: To return a shared bicycle into a docking point

examples.en: I asked where to dock the bike after finding the station near the library.
examples.zh: 找到图书馆附近的停靠点后，我问该在哪儿「把单车停进车桩」。

examples.en: The volunteer showed us where to dock the bike at the other end.
examples.zh: 志愿者给我们指出另一端哪里可以「把单车停进车桩」。

collocations: dock the bike at a station
ask where to dock the bike
find a place to dock the bike

words.enDefinition: To give a hired bicycle back after using it

examples.en: I checked whether I could return a bike at the station beside the market.
examples.zh: 我查看了能不能在市场旁的停靠点「归还一辆单车」。

examples.en: My classmate asked where to return a bike that we'd rented for the afternoon.
examples.zh: 同学问，下午租的自行车该到哪里「归还」。

collocations: return a bike to the station
look for a place to return a bike
ask where to return a bike

words.enDefinition: To finish a rental ride in the system

examples.en: The app showed where I could end the ride near the park.
examples.zh: 应用标出了我可以在公园附近哪里「结束本次骑行」。

examples.en: I checked the screen to see whether the button said End the ride.
examples.zh: 我看了一下屏幕，确认按钮是不是写着「结束本次骑行」。

collocations: find a place to end the ride

words.enDefinition: A status showing that a ride is temporarily paused

examples.en: The screen said “Ride paused” while I looked for my friend outside the museum.
examples.zh: 我在博物馆外找朋友时，屏幕显示「骑行已暂停」。

examples.en: I saw “Ride paused” beside the timer before reopening the map in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用里重新打开地图之前，看到计时器旁显示「骑行已暂停」。

words.enDefinition: A brief record of a completed bicycle ride

examples.en: My ride summary showed the two locations where I started and finished.
examples.zh: 「单次骑行详情」显示了我出发和结束的两个地点。

examples.en: I opened the ride summary to check the distance shown in the app.
examples.zh: 我打开「单次骑行详情」，查看应用里显示的骑行距离。

words.enDefinition: A message confirming that a rental bicycle was returned

examples.en: The bike return confirmation appeared after I left the station beside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 我离开体育馆旁的停靠点后，应用显示了「单车归还确认」。

examples.en: I saved the bike return confirmation with the other details of that ride.
examples.zh: 我把「单车归还确认」和那次骑行的其他细节一起保存了下来。

words.enDefinition: A list of rides taken on an account

examples.en: I looked at my ride history to find the station I used last week.
examples.zh: 我查看自己的「骑行记录」，想找上周用过的停靠点。

examples.en: The app showed my ride history after I signed in on my new phone.
examples.zh: 我在新手机上登录后，应用显示了我的「骑行记录」。

collocations: an entry in your ride history

words.enDefinition: A timer showing the duration of a rental

examples.en: The rental timer was visible at the top of the app screen.
examples.zh: 「租用计时器」显示在应用屏幕顶部。

examples.en: I checked whether the rental timer had stopped after returning the bicycle.
examples.zh: 归还自行车后，我查看了「租用计时器」有没有停。

words.enDefinition: The ride time covered by a rental fee

examples.en: I checked the included ride time before choosing a single ride pass.
examples.zh: 选单次骑行券之前，我查看了「套餐内骑行时长」。

examples.en: The screen listed the included ride time next to each option on the app.
examples.zh: 应用屏幕在每个选项旁列出了「套餐内骑行时长」。

collocations: a pass with included ride time

words.enDefinition: A pass covering one bicycle rental ride

examples.en: I chose a single ride pass for the trip from campus to the garden.
examples.zh: 我从学校骑到花园这趟买了张「单次骑行券」。

examples.en: The app showed a single ride pass beside the option for a longer membership.
examples.zh: 应用把「单次骑行券」放在期限较长的会员选项旁。

words.enDefinition: Access to bike rentals through a subscription

examples.en: The app showed my bike-share membership beside the other account details.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「共享单车会员资格」显示在其他账户信息旁。

examples.en: I asked whether the bike-share membership covered stations near both university campuses.
examples.zh: 我问这个「共享单车会员资格」是否覆盖两处校区附近的停靠点。

words.enDefinition: A charge for unlocking a rental bicycle

examples.en: I saw the unlock fee in the app before selecting a bike.
examples.zh: 我在选择单车之前，先看到了应用里的「开锁费」。

examples.en: The receipt showed the unlock fee on a separate line from other charges.
examples.zh: 收据把「开锁费」和其他费用分行列出了。

words.enDefinition: An area set aside for parking bicycles

examples.en: The park map marked designated bike parking next to the smaller gate.
examples.zh: 公园地图把较小的门旁边标为「指定自行车停放区」。

examples.en: The volunteer pointed toward designated bike parking at the back of the hall.
examples.zh: 志愿者指向大厅后面的「指定自行车停放区」。

words.enDefinition: The geographic area covered by a bicycle-sharing service

examples.en: The bike-share service area was shaded blue on the app's city map.
examples.zh: 应用的城市地图用蓝色标出了「共享单车服务范围」。

examples.en: I checked whether my new flat was inside the bike-share service area.
examples.zh: 我查了新住处是否在「共享单车服务范围」内。

words.enDefinition: An area where a rental bicycle can be returned

examples.en: The app showed a return zone beside the gate near the riverside park.
examples.zh: 应用在河边公园附近的门旁标出了一处「单车可归还区」。

examples.en: I asked whether the return zone was the entire square or one marked corner.
examples.zh: 我问「单车可归还区」是整个广场，还是标出的那个角落。

words.enDefinition: Beyond the area covered by the rental service

examples.en: The map showed my friend's building was outside the service area for these bikes.
examples.zh: 地图显示朋友住的楼「在这批共享单车的服务范围之外」。

examples.en: I saw “Outside the service area” when I tapped the street beside the museum.
examples.zh: 我点击博物馆旁那条街时，看到「超出服务范围」的提示。

collocations: a destination outside the service area
a location outside the service area

words.enDefinition: To tell the provider that a bicycle is damaged

examples.en: I found the button to report a damaged bike on the support page.
examples.zh: 我在客服页面找到了「报告单车损坏」的按钮。

examples.en: The app asked for a photo when I tried to report a damaged bike.
examples.zh: 我试着「报告单车损坏」时，应用让我上传照片。

collocations: use the app to report a damaged bike
ask how to report a damaged bike
a form to report a damaged bike

words.enDefinition: A display showing charge remaining in a battery

examples.en: I checked the battery indicator on the shared bike before choosing that one.
examples.zh: 选中那辆共享单车之前，我看了一下它的「电量指示器」。

examples.en: The bike had a small battery indicator beside the other symbols on the display.
examples.zh: 车上的显示屏有个小「电量指示器」，就在其他图标旁边。

collocations: a battery indicator on the display

words.enDefinition: To change the position of a bicycle seat

examples.en: I asked the rental worker whether I could adjust the saddle on this bicycle.
examples.zh: 我问租车工作人员能不能「调整这辆自行车的车座」。

examples.en: My classmate took a moment to adjust the saddle beside the station before leaving.
examples.zh: 出发前，同学在停靠点旁花了点时间「调整车座」。

collocations: ask how to adjust the saddle
take time to adjust the saddle
adjust the saddle before a ride

words.enDefinition: The bar used to steer a bicycle

examples.en: The handlebars on that rental bicycle had a small number printed in the middle.
examples.zh: 那辆租来的自行车的「车把」中间印了一个小号码。

examples.en: My friend spotted a tag hanging from the handlebars of the bike I rented.
examples.zh: 朋友看到我租的那辆车的「车把」上挂了一个标签。

words.enDefinition: A bell mounted on a bicycle

examples.en: I noticed a blue bike bell on the rental bike near the park.
examples.zh: 我注意到公园附近那辆租赁自行车上有一个蓝色的「自行车铃」。

examples.en: The support form let me say that the bike bell was missing completely.
examples.zh: 客服表单允许我注明这辆车的「自行车铃」不见了。

collocations: a bike bell on the handlebars
the sound of a bike bell

words.enDefinition: A basket attached to a bicycle for carrying things

examples.en: My folded jacket fit in the bike basket without taking up much space.
examples.zh: 我折好的外套放进「自行车车篮」里，占不了多少地方。

examples.en: The rental worker pointed out the bike basket on the front of that bicycle.
examples.zh: 租车工作人员指给我看那辆车前面的「自行车车篮」。

collocations: a bag in the bike basket
a rental bike with a bike basket

words.enDefinition: A folding support that holds a bicycle upright

examples.en: The rental bicycle had a kickstand on the left side behind the pedal.
examples.zh: 那辆出租自行车左侧的踏板后面有一个「脚撑」。

examples.en: The worker showed me which rental bikes had a kickstand near the rear wheel.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看哪些出租自行车在后轮附近有「脚撑」。

collocations: a bicycle resting on its kickstand

words.enDefinition: A protective helmet made for riding a bike

examples.en: The rental shop had a bike helmet on the shelf beside the front desk.
examples.zh: 租车店的前台旁边有个架子，上面放了一个「自行车头盔」。

examples.en: My classmate asked whether a bike helmet could be rented with the bicycle.
examples.zh: 同学问租自行车时能不能一起租个「自行车头盔」。

words.enDefinition: A tire that has lost most of its air

examples.en: I saw a flat tire on the rental bike and reported it in the app.
examples.zh: 我看到出租自行车上有个「没气的轮胎」，就在应用里报了问题。

examples.en: My classmate noticed the flat tire while we were still at the station.
examples.zh: 我们还在停靠点时，同学发现那个「轮胎瘪了」。

collocations: a bike with a flat tire

words.enDefinition: A pump used to add air to bicycle tires

examples.en: The map marked a bike pump next to the public repair stand.
examples.zh: 地图在公共维修架旁标出了一处「自行车打气筒」。

examples.en: I asked whether the community hall had a bike pump near its entrance.
examples.zh: 我问社区活动大厅入口附近有没有「自行车打气筒」。

words.zhGloss: 有防盗设施的自行车停放区
words.enDefinition: Bicycle parking with additional protection against theft
acceptedZhAnswers: 有防盗设施的自行车停放区

examples.en: I checked the gallery website for secure bike parking near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在美术馆网站上查了入口附近有没有「带防盗设施的自行车停放区」。

examples.en: The map showed secure bike parking behind the library rather than out front.
examples.zh: 地图显示「有防盗设施的自行车停放区」在图书馆后面，不在正门外。

collocations: a space with secure bike parking

words.enDefinition: A stand holding bicycles for basic repair work

examples.en: The bike repair stand was just beside the pump near the riverside path.
examples.zh: 「自行车自助维修架」就在河边小路附近的打气筒旁边。

examples.en: I noticed a bike repair stand next to the covered bicycle parking area.
examples.zh: 我在有顶棚的自行车停车区旁看到一个「自行车自助维修架」。

collocations: a pump beside the bike repair stand
